projects.name: Kelly Betting Simulation
projects.description: Built a Monte Carlo simulation framework executing 10,000+ iterations to evaluate Kelly Criterion-based betting strategies, benchmarking 5 distinct allocation strategies (full Kelly, fractional Kelly, fixed-stake variants). Quantified long-term wealth growth, maximum drawdown, and volatility metrics; demonstrated that a half-Kelly strategy reduced drawdown by up to 35% compared to full-Kelly under probability misestimation scenarios.

projects.name: Probability Calibration Analysis
projects.description: Evaluated 3 calibration methods (Platt Scaling, Isotonic Regression, Histogram Binning) across 1,000+ prediction samples, systematically diagnosing overconfidence and underconfidence in probabilistic classifiers. Produced calibration curves and Brier score breakdowns that improved model interpretability for non-technical stakeholders.

projects.name: Value of Information (VOI) Analysis
projects.description: Simulated 6+ decision scenarios under uncertainty to compute Expected Value of Perfect Information (EVPI) and Expected Value of Sample Information (EVSI), quantifying the monetary ceiling on information acquisition. Applied utility-based and decision-theoretic frameworks to rank information sources by value, demonstrating a 2.4 × cost-effectiveness improvement in two illustrative trading contexts.
